title: Talk and encounter scheduling
preconditions: Visit date with ≥1 Meet the Guardians talk or Wild Encounter in seed. Clear itinerary first.

steps.name: Add talk
steps.do: In wizard Meet the Guardians step, add a talk if listed.
steps.expect: Talk selected **or** Notes “none offered” and skip talk-specific steps.

steps.name: Add wild encounter
steps.do: On Wild Encounters, add one if listed.

steps.name: Finish
steps.do: Finish with talk and/or encounter (+ optional animal).

steps.name: Schedule talk
steps.do: Schedule the talk at its offered time.

steps.name: Walk-route update prompt
steps.do: If prompted about walk-route update, confirm or cancel once each as separate Notes.

steps.name: Schedule encounter
steps.do: Schedule wild encounter at its time.

steps.name: Force overlap if easy
steps.do: Schedule another item overlapping the encounter/talk.
steps.expect: Conflict/overlap flow begins **or** note unable to force.

steps.name: WE priority / shorten
steps.do: If wild-encounter overlap handling appears, follow adjust/shorten.
steps.expect: WE priority path works — or N/A.
